name: Sonneck
beschreibung:
History

The website pitztal-sonneck.at presents Haus Sonneck as a holiday house in Jerzens in the Pitztal. According to the questions page it is run by the Lentsch family, who also run the neighbouring sports shop Sport Lentsch with rental, service and a ski school. A year of construction or an older farm history is not published on the page retrieved. The address Liß 13, 6474 Jerzens, stands in the present data set. On the homepage retrieved the house number is not repeated. It is therefore not deleted as a contradiction, but it is also not issued as a new sentence of the website. The core sentence of the page is the location: the house borders directly on the valley-station area of the Hochzeigerbahn.

Getting there

The page describes the way to the cable car as a few steps, without a shuttle and without a walk on foot with the skis. A public bus line, a railway station or parking rules are not on the page retrieved. Enquiries go by email or telephone, in person and without an anonymous form. The concrete contact details are not written out as a number on the retrieved text of the homepage. Jerzens lies in the Pitztal. The Hochzeigerbahn is the mountain railway named on the page.

Tips

In winter the page names skiing and winter hiking, in summer hiking, biking and the family-friendly ZirbenPark at the Hochzeiger. The Pitztal Sommer Card is a card that is bought for further attractions in the valley, not automatically included in the house price. The house is laid out for families and groups of friends. The family, according to its own statement, puts the number of rooms and people together personally. Next door are the rental, service and ski school of Sport Lentsch. After the day on the mountain there is an in-house parlour with a bar. According to the description, jackets belong in the drying room. A price list, square metres or a check-in time are not on the page retrieved. A guest sentence from Ralph W. from Stuttgart is an opinion on the website and not a facility.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Sonneck of the Lentsch family directly at the valley station of the Hochzeigerbahn in Jerzens, with a holiday house, ski room, bar and Sport Lentsch next door.
